name: URL Heuristics
description: Zero-cost rule-based URL scoring. Rejects pagination, archives, auth pages and other web cruft before expensive scraping/LLM steps. Three-way decisions (allow / allow_hint / reject) with reasons. Shadow mode annotates without dropping anything.
usage_notes: Run after url-filter and before url-relevance to shrink the LLM batch at zero cost. Start in shadow mode (annotates only, drops nothing) and audit the flagged rejects in the UI; promote to enforce per template once rejects look trustworthy. All rule lists are template-configurable; defaults are generic web cruft only.

options.name: mode
options.label: Mode
options.description: shadow: annotate every item with decision/score/reasons, drop nothing. enforce: drop items whose decision is reject (allow_hint items are kept in both modes).

options.name: reject_url_patterns
options.label: Reject URL patterns
options.description: One case-insensitive regex per line, matched against the full URL. Any match rejects the URL outright. Lines starting with # are comments. Defaults cover generic web cruft (pagination, archives, auth, legal, feeds).

options.name: hint_url_patterns
options.label: Hint URL patterns
options.description: One case-insensitive regex per line. Matches are marked allow_hint (kept in the pool, flagged as list-like-but-possibly-useful). Lines starting with # are comments.

options.name: title_reject_patterns
options.label: Title/snippet reject patterns
options.description: One case-insensitive regex per line, matched against item title and snippet when present. A match applies one -0.5 score penalty (list-page tells). Items without title/snippet are unaffected.
options.default:
Page \d+ of
Browse all
Archive
Access denied
404
Search results

options.name: max_depth
options.label: Max path depth
options.description: Path segments before a -0.25 penalty. 0 disables the check.

options.name: max_query_params
options.label: Max query params
options.description: Query parameters before a -0.25 penalty. 0 disables the check.

options.name: hint_threshold
options.label: Hint threshold
options.description: Score below this (but at or above the reject threshold) becomes allow_hint.

options.name: needs_render_domains
options.label: Needs-render domains
options.description: One domain per line. Matching items get needs_render: true as a hint for browser-based scraping in Step 3. Subdomains match. Lines starting with # are comments.

options_defaults.title_reject_patterns:
Page \d+ of
Browse all
Archive
Access denied
404
Search results
